newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Basketball-Alaska beats Ginebra, takes 2-0 lead.
newsitem.headline: Basketball-Alaska beats Ginebra, takes 2-0 lead.

text.p: Alaska Milkmen thrashed Ginebra San Miguel 110-105 on Tuesday evening to take a commanding 2-0 lead in the best-of-seven championship series of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) third conference.

American import Sean Chambers, playing despite a sprained ankle, powered the Milkmen to victory by scoring 42 points and hauling down 11 rebounds. Fred Cofield, also an American, led Ginebra's effort with 20 points.
The two teams play their third match on Friday.
